items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: cn() and cnState(), which merges classes into a UI SDK className that may be a function of state.

items.name: tone
items.title: Tone
items.description: The Tone type: neutral, info, success, warning and destructive, the one status vocabulary of Badge, Alert, StatusPill, Progress, Meter and Toast.

items.name: theme
items.title: Theme
items.description: Semantic color tokens plus shape, density and surface tokens. The default look: rounded, roomy, soft shadows.
items.docs: Add `@layer ui-sdk;` as the first line of your global stylesheet, above `@import "tailwindcss"`, so your styles win over UI SDK's behavior CSS. The theme asks for Geist Variable and falls back to the system font: `npx shadcn add @eskais/font-geist` installs it (or add `@fontsource-variable/geist` and `@import "@fontsource-variable/geist";` yourself).

[data-palette].--link-soft: oklch(from var(--brand) clamp(0.42, l + 0.12, 0.5) calc(c * 0.55) h)

.dark [data-palette], [data-palette].dar.--primary: oklch(from var(--brand) max(l, 1.127 - l, 0.72) c h)
.dark [data-palette], [data-palette].dar.--link: oklch(from var(--brand) max(l, 1.127 - l, 0.74) c h)
.dark [data-palette], [data-palette].dar.--link-soft: oklch(from var(--brand) clamp(0.74, max(l, 1.127 - l), 0.82) calc(c * 0.55) h)

:root:where(:not(.light, [data-color-sch.--primary: oklch(from var(--brand) max(l, 1.127 - l, 0.72) c h)
:root:where(:not(.light, [data-color-sch.--link: oklch(from var(--brand) max(l, 1.127 - l, 0.74) c h)
:root:where(:not(.light, [data-color-sch.--link-soft: oklch(from var(--brand) clamp(0.74, max(l, 1.127 - l), 0.82) calc(c * 0.55) h)

@utility board-column-wash.background-image: linear-gradient( to bottom, color-mix(in oklab, var(--column-tone) 9%, transparent), transparent calc(var(--control-height-sm) + var(--gap-items)) )

theme.font-mono: "Geist Mono Variable", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

light.link-soft: oklch(from var(--brand) clamp(0.42, l + 0.12, 0.5) calc(c * 0.55) h)

dark.primary: oklch(from var(--brand) max(l, 1.127 - l, 0.72) c h)
dark.link: oklch(from var(--brand) max(l, 1.127 - l, 0.74) c h)
dark.link-soft: oklch(from var(--brand) clamp(0.74, max(l, 1.127 - l), 0.82) calc(c * 0.55) h)

items.name: theme-compact
items.title: Compact theme
items.description: Denser controls, tighter radii and padding. Applies inside any element with data-theme="compact". Also holds AgentTaskBoard's density: compact shape and spacing under data-density="compact", or data-density="auto" while the board is 75rem wide or less.

items.name: theme-glass
items.title: Glass theme
items.description: Translucent, blurred surfaces. Applies inside any element with data-theme="glass"; tune it with --glass-opacity and --glass-blur.

items.name: palettes
items.title: Colour palettes
items.description: Ready colour presets: data-palette="neutral" (the default look), "blue", "violet", "green" or "orange" on any element. Each sets the theme's --brand and neutral tint seeds; they combine with data-theme and .dark.

items.name: font-geist
items.title: Geist Variable
items.description: Geist Variable as the sans-serif font and Geist Mono Variable as the monospace font (font-mono), bundled from npm (@fontsource-variable/geist and geist-mono, OFL-1.1): no font CDN, works offline.

theme.font-mono: "Geist Mono Variable", ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, monospace

items.name: font-inter
items.title: Inter Variable
items.description: Inter Variable as the sans-serif font, bundled from npm (@fontsource-variable/inter, OFL-1.1): no font CDN, works offline.

items.name: appearance
items.title: Appearance
items.description: createAppearance and <Appearance>: keep the .dark class, data-theme and data-palette on <html> in sync with a color scheme (system follows prefers-color-scheme live, or light or dark), a theme and a palette, optionally saved between visits. Works in a static file:// page.

items.name: spinner
items.title: Spinner
items.description: An SVG spinner in currentColor, sized like an icon (sm, md, lg). Decorative by default; with a label it becomes a role=status region. Pulses instead of spinning under reduced motion.
items.docs: Decorative by default (`aria-hidden`): put it next to text that already says what is loading, or inside a Button, which shows it while pending. Pass `label` (in the page's language) when the spinner is the only sign of loading: it becomes `role="status"` with a screen-reader-only label.

items.name: button
items.title: Button
items.description: UI SDK Button with variants: async pending state, a loading prop with a spinner, focusable-when-disabled, link rendering.
items.docs: Return a Promise from `onClick` and the button stays pending until it settles: `aria-busy`, presses ignored, focus kept, a spinner, and `pendingAnnouncement` after a second. For work the button didn't start (a form submit, a mutation elsewhere), pass `loading`: it renders the same state through `disabled` + `focusableWhenDisabled`, as UI SDK documents for external pending flags. The spinner takes the leading icon's place, or sits centered over the label, so the width never changes. `size="icon"` requires `aria-label`.

items.name: field
items.title: Field
items.description: UI SDK Field parts: label, description and validation errors wired to the control.

items.name: input
items.title: Input
items.description: UI SDK Input, InputGroup and InputClear (clears and returns focus).

items.name: search-field
items.title: Search Field
items.description: Search landmark built with definePrimitive: Enter runs onSearch, Escape clears only when there is text, and agents get a submit action.

items.name: dialog
items.title: Dialog
items.description: UI SDK Dialog parts: focus trap, Escape, focus restore, dismissible and controller support.

items.name: confirm-dialog
items.title: Confirm Dialog
items.description: UI SDK AlertDialog with an async confirm action: pending, no double submit, closes on success, inline error on failure, data-agent-confirm for destructive actions.

items.name: card
items.title: Card
items.description: Card parts: a titled card renders as a section labelled by its title, with an eyebrow, a top-end action slot, a heading level on the title and card, dashed or bare surfaces.
items.docs: A `Card` renders `<section>`; once it holds a `CardTitle` it gets `aria-labelledby` pointing at the title, so it is a named region. Give the title `headingLevel` to make it a heading. `CardEyebrow` sits above the title, `CardAction` at the top end of `CardHeader`. `surface` is `card` (default), `dashed` or `none`. To keep a card out of the landmarks (a card per list item), pass `render={<div />}` or `render={<li />}`.

items.name: section
items.title: Section
items.description: A titled block of a page, composed from Card: eyebrow, title at a heading level, description, top-end action, footer; card, bare or dashed (create tile) surfaces and sm or md padding.
items.docs: `<Section title="Members" action={<Button>Invite</Button>}>…</Section>` renders a `section` named by its title (an `h2` unless `headingLevel` says otherwise). `surface="none"` keeps the heading without a box, `surface="dashed"` is the outlined tile for creating something. `padding="sm"` tightens dense dashboards.

items.name: badge
items.title: Badge
items.description: Presentational badge: tone (neutral, info, success, warning, destructive) for meaning, variant (default, secondary, outline) for an untoned look. Tone values passed as variant still work but are deprecated.

items.name: tabs
items.title: Tabs
items.description: UI SDK Tabs: arrow-key navigation, automatic or manual activation, controller support, and a selected state that reads at 3:1.

items.name: collapsible
items.title: Collapsible
items.description: UI SDK Collapsible: disclosure with aria-expanded, animated height, controller support and a rotating chevron icon.

items.name: scroll-area
items.title: Scroll Area
items.description: UI SDK ScrollArea: native scrolling with styled scrollbars, edge state and follow-to-end, keyboard-reachable when it overflows.

items.name: separator
items.title: Separator
items.description: UI SDK Separator: horizontal or vertical, announced or decorative.

items.name: avatar
items.title: Avatar
items.description: UI SDK Avatar with sizes: a real img that falls back to initials while loading or on error.

items.name: skeleton
items.title: Skeleton
items.description: Presentational loading placeholder, hidden from assistive technology, that stops pulsing under reduced motion.

items.name: empty
items.title: Empty
items.description: Presentational empty-state parts in three sizes (inline, panel, page): media, title, description and actions.

items.name: states
items.title: States
items.description: Screen states that never lie: LoadingState (spinner or skeleton, busy, label for screen readers), ErrorState (alert, retry, collapsible details) and DataState, which picks loading, error, empty or your content from a status and never shows empty while pending or after an error.
items.docs: One item, three components (`error-state`, `loading-state`, `data-state`), since DataState renders the other two and Empty by default. `<DataState status data error onRetry labels={{ errorTitle, retry, emptyTitle }}>{(data) => …}</DataState>` works with any data library: map its status to `pending`, `error` or `success`. Visible copy has no default: the types require `errorTitle` and `emptyTitle` (and `retry` with `onRetry`) unless you pass `renderError` and `empty`. `loading` and `refreshing` are screen-reader labels and default to English. While a refetch is pending, the last data stays on screen with `aria-busy` and a small spinner (`keepPreviousData`, default true); pass `fetching` for libraries whose status stays `success` during a refetch. `isEmpty` decides what counts as empty (an empty array, `null` or `undefined` by default). Every state takes `size`: `inline`, `panel` (default) or `page`.

items.name: kbd
items.title: Kbd
items.description: Presentational keyboard key and key group rendered as kbd.

items.name: table
items.title: Table
items.description: Semantic table parts with truncating cells, aria-sort-ready headers and a horizontal scroll area on narrow screens.

items.name: tooltip
items.title: Tooltip
items.description: UI SDK Tooltip parts: names or describes its trigger, opens on hover and keyboard focus, Escape closes it, optional shortcut and arrow.

items.name: popover
items.title: Popover
items.description: UI SDK Popover parts on a glass-ready surface: focus moves in, Escape and outside presses close it, focus returns to the trigger.

items.name: floating
items.title: Floating
items.description: A container that sticks to an edge of its nearest container (sticky, fixed or absolute), on the floating elevation: logical sides, safe-area insets, no viewport units. Put UI SDK controls inside, such as a Toolbar.

items.name: drawer
items.title: Drawer
items.description: UI SDK Drawer parts: a modal sheet from any edge (bottom or side), draggable, with focus trap, Escape and focus restore.

items.name: dropdown-menu
items.title: Dropdown Menu
items.description: UI SDK Menu parts with a button trigger: arrow keys, typeahead, checkbox and radio items, submenus, destructive items and async actions.

items.name: toast
items.title: Toast
items.description: UI SDK toasts: ToastStack renders a styled, announced region; toast() and createToaster() add toasts with actions, cancel and timed dismissal.

items.name: select
items.title: Select
items.description: UI SDK Select: trigger, popup list, items with a check indicator, groups and separators. Works inside Field; agents choose by label.

items.name: combobox
items.title: Combobox
items.description: UI SDK Combobox: a filtering input with clear and trigger buttons and a popup list. Works inside Field; agents choose by label.

items.name: segmented-control
items.title: Segmented Control
items.description: UI SDK SegmentedControl: one choice from a row of buttons with a sliding indicator, like a board/table view switch.

items.name: checkbox
items.title: Checkbox
items.description: UI SDK Checkbox and CheckboxGroup: checked, unchecked and indeterminate, labelled by Field.

items.name: textarea
items.title: Textarea
items.description: UI SDK Textarea: multi-line field with auto resize and a submit shortcut, labelled by Field.

items.name: quantity
items.title: Quantity
items.description: Honest values: formatQuantity() and QuantityValue show unknown as a dash, estimated with ~ and screen reader text, and the source in the title.

items.name: relative-time
items.title: Relative Time
items.description: formatRelative() and formatInstant() on Date + Intl, a RelativeTime <time> with the absolute instant in its title, and a useNow hook that pauses while the page is hidden.

items.name: acceptance-list
items.title: Acceptance List
items.description: A list of pass, fail and unverified criteria with evidence, and a segmented AcceptanceBar on the UI SDK Meter with an accessible summary.

items.name: stat
items.title: Stat
items.description: Summary figures: Stat, StatLabel, StatValue (a number, a Quantity or a node) and StatHint, in a responsive StatGroup list.

items.name: board
items.title: Board
items.description: Generic kanban layout: a named, horizontally scrolling list of columns with headers, counts, actions, collapsible columns agents can toggle by name, groups and an empty slot.

items.name: status-pill
items.title: Status Pill
items.description: Presentational status pill with the shared tones (plus muted) and an optional dot that can pulse, and StatusDot: a coloured dot with a screen reader label. The pulse stops under reduced motion.

items.name: dependency-chips
items.title: Dependency Chips
items.description: A named list of toned chips that truncate long labels, collapse past max into a +N chip, and become UI SDK Buttons agents can press when onSelect is set.

items.name: agent-task-types
items.title: Agent task types
items.description: TaskView, AttemptView, AgentRef, UsageSummary and ThreadRef: the data contract of the agent task components, plus effectiveAgent and agentDiffers.

items.name: agent-badge
items.title: Agent Badge
items.description: Provider, model and effort of an AgentRef: compact for cards (one line, long model ids cut in the middle, full text in title) or detail for panels, with a marker when the agent that ran isn't the one requested.

items.name: liveness-indicator
items.title: Liveness Indicator
items.description: A toned dot and label for an agent's computed liveness (running pulses, suspect_dead is destructive) and the time since its last activity, with now, locale and timeZone passed through.

items.name: task-status
items.title: Task Status
items.description: TaskStatusPill, AttemptStatusPill and ContextModePill: StatusPill tones and overridable labels for agent task, attempt and context mode values, with the source thread for reuse and fork.

items.name: usage
items.title: Usage
items.description: Token, time and cost usage of an agent task: UsageStat for a card and UsageTable on Table, with compact counts, the exact value in the title, honest unknown and estimated values, and summaries side by side as columns.

items.name: attempt-timeline
items.title: Attempt Timeline
items.description: An agent task's attempts on the UI SDK Timeline: kind, status, times, configured and executed route with earlier routes in a popover, context, repairs, checks, commits, blockers, thread links agents can press, usage per attempt and older attempts behind a toggle.

items.name: agent-task-board-core
items.title: Agent Task Board core
items.description: The non-visual core of AgentTaskBoard: filter, group, sort and summarize tasks; English and Spanish labels; and the board and proposals primitives whose agent actions select, filter, switch views, open threads and decide proposals.

items.name: proposal-actions
items.title: Proposal Actions
items.description: Approve and Reject for one task proposal: async pending with no double submit, inline errors, an on-screen reject confirmation, and agent access set by agentApproval (confirm, allow or deny). Renders nothing in snapshot mode.

items.name: task-card
items.title: Task Card
items.description: A compact agent task card: id, two-line title, profile, active agent, liveness, acceptance bar, attempts and cost, dependency chips, blocker with its retry time, decision and analysis-mode markers, and proposal actions in live mode. A stretched UI SDK Button selects it without nesting other controls.

items.name: task-detail-panel
items.title: Task Detail Panel
items.description: An agent task's goal, acceptance and evidence, dependencies that select their task, the pending decision with proposal actions, usage and the attempt timeline. TaskDetailPanel shows it as a non-modal panel; TaskDetailDialog as a modal dialog or a right-side drawer. Escape and a close button close either.

items.name: agent-task-board
items.title: Agent Task Board
items.description: The full board for AI agent tasks: filters, search, a board or sortable table view, a summary, collapsible status columns with ready and waiting groups, a detail dialog, drawer or side panel, compact density on narrow hosts, snapshot and live modes, English and Spanish labels, and agent actions to select, filter, switch views, open threads and decide proposals.

items.name: accordion
items.title: Accordion
items.description: UI SDK Accordion parts: triggers in headings, Enter and Space toggle, animated panels on the density tokens.

items.name: hover-card
items.title: Hover Card
items.description: UI SDK Hover Card on the popover surface: a link that previews where it goes on hover or keyboard focus.

items.name: context-menu
items.title: Context Menu
items.description: UI SDK Menu opened by right-click, long press or Shift+F10 on a focusable area, with the dropdown menu's items.

items.name: menubar
items.title: Menubar
items.description: UI SDK Menubar: one tab stop, arrow keys between menus, with the dropdown menu's surface and items.

items.name: navigation-menu
items.title: Navigation Menu
items.description: UI SDK Navigation Menu: a named landmark of triggers that disclose panels of links, each panel on the popover surface.

items.name: breadcrumb
items.title: Breadcrumb
items.description: Presentational breadcrumb trail: a navigation named Breadcrumb, an ordered list and aria-current on the current page.

items.name: pagination
items.title: Pagination
items.description: UI SDK Pagination that works standalone: page, pageCount or total and pageSize, onPageChange with details, overridable labels.

items.name: command
items.title: Command
items.description: UI SDK Command list with search, groups, empty state and Kbd shortcuts, plus a CommandDialog palette with an opt-in mod+K trigger.

items.name: radio-group
items.title: Radio Group
items.description: UI SDK RadioGroup and Radio: pick one with arrow keys, named by Field.

items.name: switch
items.title: Switch
items.description: UI SDK Switch with its thumb: an on/off setting that sits in a row beside its Field label.

items.name: slider
items.title: Slider
items.description: UI SDK Slider: one value or a range, with a formatted value part, named by Field.

items.name: toggle
items.title: Toggle
items.description: UI SDK Toggle: a button that stays pressed, with variants and sizes.

items.name: toggle-group
items.title: Toggle Group
items.description: UI SDK ToggleGroup: toggles sharing one value with arrow-key focus, named by Field.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: UI SDK OTPInput: one native input shown as slots, with paste and one-time-code autofill.

items.name: number-input
items.title: Number Input
items.description: UI SDK NumberInput: typed, stepped and formatted numbers with step buttons, named by Field.

items.name: label
items.title: Label
items.description: UI SDK Label: names any control by htmlFor, including a radio group, slider or switch.

items.name: progress
items.title: Progress
items.description: UI SDK Progress: a task's progress, determinate or indeterminate, with label and value.

items.name: meter
items.title: Meter
items.description: UI SDK Meter: a reading within a known range, like storage used.

items.name: alert
items.title: Alert
items.description: Presentational alert with the shared tones (neutral, info, success, warning, destructive), a trailing action slot, long text that wraps, and an opt-in live role.
items.docs: Put an optional icon (`aria-hidden`), `AlertTitle` and `AlertDescription` inside. `action` takes a trailing Button; it moves below the text when the alert is narrower than 28rem. An alert is not a live region by default: pass `live` for one that appears after the page loads, and it becomes `role="alert"` for warning and destructive tones and `role="status"` otherwise. `announce` still works and is deprecated.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Calendar
items.description: UI SDK Calendar: a month grid with arrow, Page Up/Down and Home/End keys, single, multiple or range selection, several months, min/max and unavailable dates, locale and timeZone.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Date Picker
items.description: UI SDK Date Picker: type a date in the locale's format or pick it from a calendar popup, single or range, with a format hint, an optional clear button and ISO values.

items.name: carousel
items.title: Carousel
items.description: UI SDK Carousel: native scroll-snap slides with Previous and Next, arrow keys, indicators and optional rotation; agents page it by name.

items.name: resizable
items.title: Resizable
items.description: UI SDK Resizable: panels with named separator handles that move with the pointer or arrow keys, collapse with Enter and can save their layout.

items.name: sidebar
items.title: Sidebar
items.description: App navigation: a named landmark with groups and items (href or a router link), the current page marked with aria-current, collapsing to an icon rail with tooltips and opening in a drawer on narrow screens. Agents collapse and expand it by name.
items.docs: Put a `SkipLink` first in `<body>`, before the `Sidebar`, so keyboard users can jump past the navigation, and give the page content the target: `<SkipLink>Skip to content</SkipLink><Sidebar …/><PageLayout as="main">…</PageLayout>` (PageLayout renders `<main id="main">`). If your shell renders `<main>` itself, give it `id="main" tabIndex={-1}`.

items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Generic typed table: sortable columns with aria-sort, optional row selection with a mixed select-all, loading and empty states, and pagination through renderPagination. Sort, selection and page are controlled or not, and agents can sort, select and page it.

items.name: skip-link
items.title: Skip Link
items.description: A link to the main content that stays hidden until it takes keyboard focus, then floats at the top start of the viewport above everything else.
items.docs: Render it first in `<body>`: `<SkipLink>Skip to content</SkipLink>`. The text is required (write it in the page's language); `href` defaults to `#main`, which `PageLayout as="main"` provides. See the Sidebar docs for where it goes in an app shell.

items.name: page-layout
items.title: Page Layout
items.description: A page's column: centered at a dense (73.75rem), wide (90rem) or full width, with page gutters and gap-section between blocks, a header slot, and a workspace variant without padding for app-like screens.
items.docs: `<PageLayout header={<PageHeader … />}>…</PageLayout>`. It renders a `div` by default, because the app shell often owns `<main>`; pass `as="main"` when the page is the main content, and it renders `<main id="main" tabIndex={-1}>` (pass `id` to change it) so a SkipLink reaches it. It is never a live region: announce changes from the component that changes (an Alert with `live`, a DataState). `variant="workspace"` drops the gutters and the width cap, for screens that lay out their own panes.

items.name: page-header
items.title: Page Header
items.description: Presentational page header: an eyebrow, a title at the heading level you choose, a description, an actions slot that wraps below the title on narrow screens, a breadcrumb slot and a tabs slot.
items.docs: The title is an `h1` by default (`headingLevel` changes it) with a generated id, or `titleId`, for `aria-labelledby`. `eyebrow` is a small uppercase kicker above it. `tabs` takes a `TabsList` under the title row: wrap the page in `Tabs` so the list and its `TabsPanel`s share a root, and name the list with `aria-label`.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter Bar
items.description: A UI SDK Toolbar of filters with one tab stop and arrow keys, a search field inside it, and a reset button that shows while filters apply.

items.name: chart
items.title: Chart
items.description: Recharts v3 composed with Eskais tokens: ChartContainer maps a config to --color-<key> variables (light and dark), popover tooltips and legends, and ChartDataTable renders the same data as a table for screen readers and agents. The container is a figure that requires a name.
items.docs: Categorical series use --chart-1 to --chart-5. Series with a meaning use the series tokens, which follow the theme and meet 3:1 on the background and card in both modes: --series-positive (gains, done; from --success), --series-negative (losses, failures; from --destructive), --series-target (a goal or reference line; from --foreground) and --series-remaining (what is left, a track; from --muted-foreground over --muted). Pass them as a config color, e.g. { done: { label: "Done", color: "var(--series-positive)" } }, or use the Tailwind colours (stroke-series-target). Don't rely on colour alone: add a legend or labels, and dash a target line.

items.name: lightbox
items.title: Lightbox
items.description: A UI SDK Dialog that shows one image of a set: previous and next (buttons and arrow keys), a counter, the caption, an open-original link and fit or actual size. Dark variants follow the theme with no flash; agents get next, previous and goTo.
items.docs: Pass `items` ({ id, src, srcDark?, alt, name?, href? }) and control `open`/`onOpenChange` and `index`/`onIndexChange`, or put a `DialogTrigger` inside as children. `srcDark` is rendered next to `src` and CSS shows it under `.dark` or the system dark preference (unless `<html>` opts into light), so there is no flash. Focus returns to the trigger, or to whatever was focused when it opened; pass `finalFocus` to override. The dialog is sized in % of the top layer, never viewport units. Labels are English and overridable through `labels`. Agents see `Image viewer` with `next`, `previous` and `goTo(index)` (0-based).

items.name: attachments
items.title: Attachments
items.description: AttachmentStrip: a horizontally scrolling strip of image thumbnails and file chips (icon, name, type and size). Images open a Lightbox, files open their link, max adds a +N button. AttachmentThumb renders one. Agents get openAttachment(id).
items.docs: Each attachment is { id, name, kind: "image" | "file", src, srcDark?, thumbnail?, thumbnailDark?, alt, href?, size?, mimeType? }. Dark variants are rendered beside the light ones and CSS shows the one that matches the theme (`.dark`, or the system preference unless the page opted into light), so there is no flash. `onOpen(attachment, details)` runs before anything opens, for people and agents (`details.source === "agent"`); `details.cancel()` keeps it closed. Sizes are formatted with Intl in `locale`. The strip needs an `aria-label`; the other labels are English and overridable through `labels` (`open`, `more`, `lightbox`). Focus returns to the thumbnail that opened the lightbox.

items.name: stage-track
items.title: Stage Track
items.description: Where a piece of work is in a configurable pipeline (branch, PR, dev, prod): StageTrack shows every stage in a row, reached ones filled and the current one emphasised, or only the current one as a StagePill. StageFilter is a toggle group with a count per stage.
items.docs: Stages are { id, label, tone? } with the shared Tone vocabulary; a stage without a tone uses the primary colour, and StagePill defaults to info. `current` is a stage id; stages before it count as reached. The track is an ordered list with `aria-current="step"` on the current stage, and each state has its own marker shape (check, ring, hollow), so meaning never rests on colour; give it an `aria-label`. Below a 24rem container it stacks into a column. `getHref(stage)` makes a stage a link. StageFilter is a UI SDK ToggleGroup (several stages by default, `multiple={false}` for one): nothing pressed means no filter, which a segmented control can't express. Agents set it with `setValue` and stage ids.

items.name: list-item
items.title: List Item
items.description: Dense, Linear-style rows that also work as entity cards: List, ListGroup (label and count), ListItem with leading, title, subtitle, status, meta, trailing and actions, plus ListItemTitle, ListItemMeta, ListItemActions and IconTile. Agents get select(id).
items.docs: `List aria-label` holds `ListItem`s, optionally inside `ListGroup label count`. A row selects through a stretched link (`href`, `aria-current="page"` when `selected`) or a stretched UI SDK Button (`onSelect`), and its actions, chips and status stay their own targets. Give `List` a `value`, `defaultValue` or `onValueChange` and the rows become options of a UI SDK Listbox (arrow keys, one tab stop); options can't hold controls, so `actions` are ignored there. `variant="card"` lays rows out as cards in a responsive grid. Titles wrap to two lines, then show the full title in a tooltip; a status pill wraps below a narrow title, and trailing content and actions drop to their own line on a narrow row. `List onSelect(id, details)` runs before a row is chosen, for people and agents, and `details.cancel()` stops it. Agents see the list by its label with `select(id)`.
